Text: {D(Character)} is always begging to go on an expedition with you

{He(Character)}’s still young, but you can’t put it off forever. During a briefing with {d(Techhead)}, {d(Character)} storms in.

“Please take me with you! I’ll be useful!” {he(Character)} exclaims.
You laugh: “You don’t even know the nature of this expedition!”
“You’re visiting an old colony!” {he(Character)} crows. “{Techhead} told me!”

You glance at {d(Techhead)}, who is too slow to hide {his(Techhead)} smile. You sigh. It should be safe. Maybe it’s time the little one came along.
Is allowed to go on an expedition
En route to the old colony, you pass one of its small moons

You’re about to quiz {d(Character)} on natural satellites and Hill spheres when {he(Character)} interrupts you.

“Look!” {he(Character)} shouts. “Something on the moon!”
“That’s ridic–” You stop yourself and look out the window. Nothing. “Don’t try to change the subject!” you scold {him(Character)}.

“It’s true! Look again!” {d(Character)} insists. You resort to your onboard cameras. {He(Character)}’s right: there are unnatural structures down there.

“Can we go?” {he(Character)} pleads.
You hesitate, then turn to the ship’s AI: “Initiate landing protocol.”

{Character} beams from ear to ear.
You don your suits and exit the spacecraft

The structures are carved from the moon's rock, but they’re too small for living quarters; strange. You signal your security to stay close, and take one of the paths into the maze. {D(Character)} races around in excitement as you pass arches and temples. The ancient inscriptions are unintelligible, but you make out names. Dates. You sigh. “It’s a graveyard.” {D(Character)} frowns. After a long silence, {he(Character)} asks: “Why do we have to die?”
Without an ending, there can be no beginning. Death gives life meaning.

You and {d(Character)} walk in silence

This is not what you expected from your first expedition together. 

“Hey!” {d(Character)} exclaims suddenly. “Another ship’s landing!”

It’s ragtag. No House emblem. You hide behind a large headstone and draw your sidearm. {D(Character)} cowers next to you.

Two shapes appear carrying shovels. They stop at a nearby tomb. You nod to your escort and quietly surround the gravediggers.
“This is the end of your gravedigging career, filth! Hands up!”

Shovels drop.
“Put them in the cargo bay,” you command. “We'll inspect their ship.”
The bandits didn’t bother to lock up

Inside you find plenty of ancient artifacts. 

“Fascinating,” {d(Character)} whispers. “They were kept with the dead?”
You nod. “Some cultures believed the dead could take them with them.”
“Where?” {d(Character)} asks. 

You smile. “That’s a story for another time.”
“So, what do we do with these things?” {he(Character)} asks.

You stop at a family crypt. Some of their lives spanned a century... others less than a year. You try to hurry on, but {d(Character)}’s already seen it.

{He(Character)} looks up. “I think I understand. I could turn a hundred, I could die tomorrow. That shouldn’t change what I do.
We have to make the most of the time we have.”
